title: Episode 83 — Hindal Squanders the Guru's Grace

blocks.text: The episode turns from remembered grace to remembered failure. He could not maintain and preserve the Guru's rare gift, so the blessing that should have deepened humility instead feeds imitation, vanity, and spiritual ambition.

The page condemns Hindal for copying the Guru's institutions while draining them of obedience. He builds rival structures, cultivates followers around himself, and begins to treat borrowed sanctity as if it were his own inheritance.

What began as proximity to the Guru is therefore rewritten as a cautionary tale. The deeper charge is not mere error but the deliberate squandering of a gift that should have produced devotion and truthful service.
